evidence_frontier: The latest completed evidence is the 100‑epoch w8 confirmation (seeds 42‑46) which passed its preregistered gate (aggregate Q.ANT correct 444 ≥ 448‑10). Earlier width‑compression experiments (Exp021) showed w8 and w12 under‑performed the w16 control (887 and 884 vs 897) but only w8 has been confirmed. No confirmation experiment for w12 exists on fresh seeds.
analysis: Observation: w8, the narrowest tested width, meets the performance gate when evaluated on a fresh seed set for 100 epochs. w12 has not been evaluated under the same confirmation protocol, so its robustness is unknown. Hypothesis: If the performance degradation between w12 and w16 is modest, w12 will also satisfy the same gate on a fresh seed set, indicating that intermediate widths retain the robustness demonstrated by w8. This hypothesis is falsifiable by a direct 100‑epoch confirmation experiment on ECG200 with new seeds.
hypothesis: On a fresh set of seeds, the w12 candidate will achieve aggregate Q.ANT correct predictions that are no more than 10 fewer than the w16 control (i.e., w12_correct ≥ w16_correct ‑ 10) after 100 training epochs on ECG200.

proposal.title: 100‑epoch w12 Confirmation on ECG200
proposal.research_question: Does a local representation width of 12 preserve performance within the predefined gate relative to the w16 control when evaluated on a fresh seed set?
proposal.rationale: w8 has been confirmed as viable; w12 remains untested under the same rigorous protocol. Confirming w12 will map the width‑performance curve and assess whether intermediate compression levels maintain the robustness of the promoted architecture without being labeled as the minimal viable width.

procedure: Train Alpha5 models with local_width 12 and 16 on the ECG200 training split (100 samples) for 100 epochs using the same learning rate and batch size as prior experiments.
Evaluate each trained model on the ECG200 test split (100 samples) for each seed, recording Q.ANT correct predictions.
Aggregate Q.ANT correct counts across the 5 seeds (500 predictions per model).
Apply the preregistered gate: w12_correct ≥ w16_correct ‑ 10.

proposal.success_criteria: If the aggregated Q.ANT correct count for the w12 candidate is at least (w16_correct ‑ 10) over the 500 test predictions, the experiment is a success.
proposal.risks: Potential failure to meet the gate, which would limit conclusions about intermediate widths; compute cost for training multiple models; results are limited to the ECG200 benchmark and may not generalize to other time‑series datasets.
